objective: Remove completed tickets from the active rail without changing the store contract.

constraints.statement: Completed tickets must not appear in active().
constraints.evidence_condition: target-completed-ticket changes from FAIL to PASS.

constraints.statement: Existing add, delete, and validation behavior must remain stable.
constraints.evidence_condition: preserve-store-contract passes on zero-change and code.

constraints.statement: Only the Spike candidate is mutable.
constraints.evidence_condition: The source Spike repository remains unchanged.
Actual execution time and output bytes are recorded.

non_goals: Modify Mosaic constitution or hidden evaluators

acceptance_criteria.statement: A completed ticket is absent from active().
The existing store contract remains compatible.

tasks.description: Establish that TicketStore.active causes the reported behavior.
